newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Optus sees no effect from cable rollout rules.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Optus sees no effect from cable rollout rules.

text.p: Optus Communications Pty Ltd chief operating officer Phil Jacobs said on Wednesday that the Australian government's ruling on guidelines for fibre-optic cable rollout by local telecommunications carriers should not effect Optus.
"We plan to have the initial part of the rollout complete by July 1997 anyway, so I would say that it would not have a negative impact on the rollout," Jacobs said.
The Australian government said on Tuesday that the last above ground cabling would have to be installed by the end of September 1997.
Jacobs said Optus planned to have 2.5 million homes connected by the finish of the rollout.
Optus would then carry local telephony, pay television and interactive sevices through its network.
The cable rollout is being conducted by Optus Pay Television offshoot, Optus Vision, in which it owns a 46.5 percent stake.
Optus Communications is 25 percent owned by Mayne Nickless Ltd and 24.5 percent each by BellSouth Corp and Cable and Wireless Plc.
